title: Totems of Hircine
description: Aela the Huntress asks the player to retrieve a Totem of Hircine from a dungeon and return it to the Underforge in Whiterun, where it grants a new Beast Form power.

base_facts: Aela is a Companion and a werewolf who reveres Hircine.
She seeks the Totems of Hircine to restore the Companions' ancient traditions.
She accompanies the player as a Shield-Sister to retrieve each totem.

QUEST_ACCEPTED: Aela has asked the player to retrieve a Totem of Hircine from a dungeon.
TOTEM_RETRIEVED: The totem has been recovered from the dungeon and must be brought to the Underforge.
TOTEM_PLACED: The totem has been placed in the Underforge, granting a new Beast Form power.
QUEST_COMPLETED: Aela prays at the newly placed totem in the Underforge upon quest completion and will remain there for some time.
Aela awarded the player a leveled amount of gold for recovering the totem.
While praying at the totem, Aela initially only offers Animal Extermination work; she may offer the next totem quest after the player leaves and returns to the Underforge.
Aela can offer this quest up to three times total, one for each of the three Totems of Hircine still to be recovered.

beats.comment: Aela offers the totem quest when asked about work.
Player retrieves the totem from the dungeon.
Player places the totem in the Underforge.
